DaggerML records research computations as durable, inspectable, cacheable DAGs.

- [Get started](getting-started.qmd): create a research project and record a first DAG.
- [Use DaggerML](use/README.qmd): create, run, inspect, and share research.
- [Extend DaggerML](extend/index.qmd): build adapters, executors, codecs, and integrations.
- [Develop DaggerML](develop/README.qmd): contribute to DaggerML itself.
- [Examples](examples/index.qmd): worked Python lessons and matching downloads.
- [Sharp bits and security](sharp-bits-and-security.qmd): operational caveats and known security limitations.
- [Glossary](glossary.qmd): shared terms.
